insurer: Cholamandalam MS General Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.note: Basic plan: ₹2,000/day room rent limit for SI ₹50k–₹2L; no room limit for SI above ₹2L under Basic; Plus and Premiere plans have no room rent sub-limits.

icu.note: ICU charges are covered as part of in-patient hospitalisation expenses; no separate ICU sub-limit stated in the policy wording.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned in the policy wording for any age group or plan.

sub_limits.display: Few sub-limits (ambulance, RTA bonus, maternity, newborn)
sub_limits.note: Ambulance capped at 1% of SI (max ₹2,000–₹5,000/hosp by plan); RTA additional SI capped at ₹3L–₹5L; maternity capped at ₹50k–₹1L; newborn cover capped at 10% of SI or ₹50k; no disease-wise sub-limits on core hospitalisation.

deductible.note: No aggregate or base deductible mentioned.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: Basic and Plus plans: 36 months PED waiting. Premiere plan: 24 months PED waiting. Base value reported is 36 months (Basic/Plus); Premiere offers 24 months.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions (cataract, hernia, joint replacement, etc.) have a 24-month specific waiting period across all plans.

maternity.note: Inbuilt under Plus (₹50,000/delivery) and Premiere (₹1L/delivery) plans after 36 months continuous coverage; limited to first two deliveries. Not available under Basic plan.

cumulative_bonus.note: Basic plan max CB is 50%; Plus and Premiere plans max CB is 100%. Rate per year: 10%–50% per year depending on plan (schedule shows 10%–50% range for Basic and 50%–100% for Plus/Premiere). CB reduces on claim.

restoration.note: Triggered after Base SI and earned Cumulative Bonus are exhausted/insufficient. Available for subsequent claims in the same policy year. Not applicable for RTA additional SI, maternity, infertility, bariatric surgery, home care, or global hospitalisation claims.

pre_hosp.note: Basic plan: 30 days pre-hospitalisation. Plus and Premiere plans: 60 days.

post_hosp.note: Basic: 60 days; Plus: 90 days; Premiere: 120 days post-hospitalisation cover.

day_care.display: All day-care procedures covered up to SI
day_care.note: Day care procedures covered up to sum insured across all plans.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered across all plans; excludes asthma, bronchitis, arthritis, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, diarrhoea, chronic nephritis, pyrexia of unknown origin.

ayush.note: AYUSH hospitalisation and day care covered up to sum insured across all plans in recognised AYUSH hospitals/day care centres.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor hospitalisation expenses for harvesting covered; donor pre/post-hospitalisation and other treatment not covered.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance: 1% of SI subject to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation for Basic and Plus plans; ₹5,000 per hospitalisation for Premiere plan.

modern_treatments.note: Modern/advanced treatments are covered as part of in-patient hospitalisation expenses; no specific sub-limit stated for robotic surgery or other modern treatments.

consumables.note: Consumables cover (Annexure 1 List 1 items) is inbuilt under Plus and Premiere plans; not available under Basic plan. Excludes personal comfort items, external durable devices, and non-medically necessary items.

global_cover.note: Global hospitalisation cover inbuilt in Premiere plan up to Base SI; diagnosis must be in India; only in-patient and day care expenses covered; reimbursement only. Not available under Basic or Plus plans.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim or policy can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 15 days for monthly premium payment mode and 30 days for all other modes.

free_look.note: 30-day free look period from date of receipt of policy document for new policies; not applicable on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: Portability to other insurers allowed as per IRDAI guidelines; apply at least 45 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: Alcoholic cirrhosis (permanent), impotence treatment, gender change, adventure sports (professional), war, nuclear/bio/chem terrorism, external congenital anomalies

optional_riders.display: Medical Second Opinion add-on, Flexi OP Care add-on (OPD consultations, diagnostics, dental, pharmacy discounts)
